jobs.description:
Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:

• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
• Good physical condition for physical work.
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
• “You are open to working weekends.

Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

Jobomschrijving

As a Back-up Team Leader, you act as the right hand of the Team Leader. In their absence, you take full responsibility for the daily operations and ensure that warehouse activities run smoothly and efficiently. Together, you maintain high quality standards, productivity, and a positive working environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and deputize for the Team Leader in daily operational management
• Coordinate, guide, and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety performance
• Report progress, results, and any operational issues to management
• Proactively contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives

Do you reconisze yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed nightshift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As a Quality Controller, you work closely with the quality and production teams to ensure that our products not only meet the strictest standards, but also end up on store shelves with pride.

 
• 
80% inspections on the workfloor/production <> 20% desk work (registration/documentation of performed checks)

 
• 
Visual inspections of packaging and labeling

 
• 
Monitoring quality standards and improving them where possible

 
• 
Providing support during audits or certifications (BRC, IFS, Organic, customer audits...)

 
• 
Coaching among employees to strengthen quality awareness

Does reading this set of responsibilities already spark your interest? Read on and find out what we expect from you:

 
• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience in a food production environment

 
• 
Experience with BRC and IFS standards

 
• 
A good knowledge of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate smoothly with colleagues

 
• 
You have a critical mindset and a strong eye for detail

 
• 
Your insights and observations contribute to maintaining and improving the quality level of our products

 
• 
You are willing to work in a cold environment (5–10 °C), including about half an hour per day performing checks in the freezer (-18 °C)

 
• 
You are comfortable working with MS Office and Outlook

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You oversee the production process and, together with your team, ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

 
• 
You monitor the operation of 3 automatic packaging machines

 
• 
You manage 3 operators and 2 forklift drivers and provide guidance throughout their work

 
• 
You actively work on the machines yourself and step in wherever needed

 
• 
You set up, monitor, and adjust the packaging machines

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, safety, efficiency, and production planning

 
• 
You carry out checks on products and packaging

 
• 
You identify malfunctions and deviations and resolve them yourself whenever possible

 
• 
You ensure an efficient distribution of tasks and clear communication within the team

 
• 
You are the first point of contact for employees on the production floor

Do you know automatic packaging lines inside out, enjoy taking a hands-on approach, and at the same time know how to keep an overview of both your team and the production process? Then this Team Leader position could be a great fit for you.

 
• 
Experience working with an automatic packaging line is essential

 
• 
You have strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality

 
• 
Experience with CPS, multihead weighers, checkweighers, metal detection systems and/or automatic stackers is an advantage

 
• 
Experience managing or coordinating a team is an asset

 
• 
You have natural leadership skills and the maturity required to take responsibility

 
• 
You have good organisational and communication skills

 
• 
You communicate very well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is essential, as you will be managing operators and forklift drivers who speak Dutch, English, or French

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. Our kitchen operates at the highest level of contemporary gastronomy, where craftsmanship, discipline, and perfection are at the heart of everything we do.
 

We are looking for an experienced, structured, and creative baker. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily production of bread and bakery products at the highest gastronomic level. You will work closely with the kitchen team to ensure consistency, quality, and flawless execution, directly contributing to the overall guest experience.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Preparing and baking artisan breads and bakery products according to Boury’s quality standards; 

• Managing the daily mise en place and production planning for bakery products; 

• Contributing to a professional, disciplined, and team-oriented working environment; 

• Continuously striving for improvement in techniques, efficiency, and quality. 
 

• You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience within a high-quality bakery or gastronomic environment. 

• You have a genuine passion and interest in products, craftsmanship, and the continuous pursuit of excellence. 

• You are motivated to work at the highest gastronomic level and have an eye for detail, consistency, and quality. 

• You are comfortable working during weekends and understand the commitment required within a top-level culinary environment. 

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus. 

• You are a team-oriented professional with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a willingness to continuously improve your techniques and contribute to the team.

Our distinguished firm, with a team of 900 advisors across the Benelux, Switzerland, and global financial centers, serves as the preferred legal and tax partner for businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Switzerland.

Clients benefit from personalized counsel, leveraging our full-service approach, sector-specific expertise, and extensive market knowledge.

Jobomschrijving

What will be your responsibilities?

• Facilitate the incorporation of new clients and commencement of matters.
• Aid in the arrangement and subsequent follow-up of invoicing procedures.
• Supervise the adherence to Know Your Client (KYC) identification protocols.
• Track and ensure compliance with Bar points.
• Handle document archiving, uphold database accuracy, and manage printing responsibilities.
• Deliver comprehensive administrative assistance, encompassing the creation of PowerPoint presentations, coordinating travel logistics, and overseeing timesheet management.
• Effectively organize schedules, arrange appointments with clients and colleagues, and manage logistics for recruitment interviews.
• Serve as a substitute for other administrative assistants when necessary.

can you recognise yourself in this?

• Demonstrate a proficient command of English and possess a solid passive understanding of either Dutch or French.
• Hold a high school diploma, a bachelor's degree (although not obligatory), or can present equivalent work experience.
• Exhibit a comprehensive understanding of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Display an inclination for financial and billing systems, expressing a genuine enjoyment of numerical work.
• Showcase robust organizational skills, characterized by a high degree of structure and the ability to effectively prioritize tasks.
• Set yourself apart through precision, accuracy, and a commitment to thoroughness in your work.
• Proactively approach tasks with a customer-centric and service-oriented mindset.
• Flourish in a collaborative team-oriented environment.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Our client is seeking an experienced Customer Service Manager to oversee customer service operations, drive continuous improvement, and lead a high-performing team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Manager your responsibilities are:

• Lead and manage the customer service team to ensure high performance and efficiency.
• Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
• Monitor and improve operational processes to ensure seamless service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide effective resolutions.
• Analyse customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.
• Collaborate with other departments to align customer service goals with overall business objectives.
• Prepare and present reports on customer service performance to senior management.

A successful Customer Service Manager should have:

• Master's degree or equivalent higher education qualification
• Minimum 10 years of experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment
• At least 5 years of leadership experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations or Business Management
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English 
• Experience in exposure to executive leadership and cross-functional decision-making
• Strong background in change management and organizational transformation
• Experience working in complex international B2B environments

The Finance Officer will handle key accounting and finance tasks, ensuring accurate financial records and compliance with regulations. 

Client Details

The company is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Our client is a prestigious law firm based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

As a German-speaking Partner Secretary, your responsibilities are:

• Manage the Partner's agenda and coordinate meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements
• Handle correspondence, emails, and phone calls in German and English
• Prepare and format legal documents, presentations, and reports
• Organize and maintain digital and physical filing systems
• Liaise with clients and internal departments in a professional and confidential manner
• Assist with billing and time entry
• Support in the organization of events and internal meetings

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar role, ideally within a law firm or professional services environment
• You speak German with an excellent command of English (spoken and written); French is a plus
• Strong organizational and communication skills
• Proficient in MS Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
• Discreet, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure with a high level of professionalism

Our client is a rapidly growing organization active in the healthcare sector and part of a large international group. Despite its strong backing, the company maintains an entrepreneurial, start-up-like environment with significant transformation projects underway.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Payroll & Administration Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage the monthly payroll process in collaboration with the social secretariat.
• Ensure accurate payroll closures and perform payroll validations.
• Compare and reconcile time management and payroll data.
• Handle payroll corrections and follow-up actions where necessary.
• Support HR administration activities, including contracts, onboarding, and offboarding.
• Coordinate payroll-related queries through the ticketing system and liaise with internal stakeholders.
• Provide support on HR and payroll projects across multiple legal entities and clinics.

A successful Freelance Payroll & Administration Officer should have:

• Proven experience in end-to-end payroll administration.
• Strong knowledge of Belgian payroll and social legislation.
• Experience working with social secretariats and payroll providers.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, less structured, entrepreneurial environment.
• Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Hands-on mentality and ability to work independently.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good command of English; French is a plus.
• Experience with Workday, ADP, SAP, or similar systems is considered an asset.

Our client is a leading international healthcare and pharmaceutical services organization, supporting customers worldwide through specialized logistics and supply chain solutions.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor customs declarations to ensure compliance with customs regulations and procedures.
• Manage and update electronic transit records and customs documentation.
• Prepare supplementary customs declarations for import shipments.
• Communicate with customs authorities, regulatory bodies, clients, and internal stakeholders.
• Resolve customs-related queries and support smooth import operations.
• Ensure accurate record-keeping and maintain high-quality administrative standards.
• Prioritize multiple tasks and timelines in a fast-paced logistics environment.
• Work with internal logistics and IT systems to process and track shipments

• First experience in logistics, customs, import/export, supply chain, or an administrative operational role.
• Strong administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English (written and spoken).
• Comfortable communicating with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Able to work independently while contributing effectively within a team.
• Organized, proactive, and capable of managing priorities under pressure.

jobs.occupation: Office & Facility Administrative Assistant - Part Time 3/5th
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international company active in life sciences sector, known for its strong focus on innovation, research, and high-quality standards. With a collaborative culture and a commitment to employee well-being, they offer a dynamic work environment where people can grow, contribute, and make a real impact. The company is located at the border of Brussels/Zaventem and easily accessible by public transport from Brussels and surroundings.

Jobomschrijving

As Office/Facility & Administrative Coordinator you'll:

• Act as first contact for all facilities questions and service requests.
• Keep documents, records, and vendor information organised and up to date.
• Manage ticketing system by assigning requests and ensuring timely follow-up.
• Coordinate small office moves, furniture needs, and daily workplace logistics.
• Help organise supplier visits, meetings, and on-site interventions.
• Support QHSE activities by maintaining safety documentation and assisting with inspections.

• Fluent in English and French or Dutch
• Previous experience in administrative support, office management, or facilities coordination.
• Strong organisational, communication, and interpersonal skills with a customer-focused, solution-oriented mindset.
• Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and confidence using MS Office.
• Comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a dynamic environment.

Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills in English and French; additional languages are a strong asset.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

As a Bilingual Accountant in the public sector, you will manage financial operations AZ and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. This position offers a variety of responsibilities and benefits for a skilled professional in accounting and finance.

Client Details

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Description

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.
